exposure: Umbilical cord macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF) levels
cohort: The study included 86 preterm infants, comprising 38 with Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) and 48 without RDS.
finding: Cord serum macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF) levels were significantly higher in preterm infants with RDS compared to those without RDS.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in delivery mode between the RDS and non-RDS groups.
birth_weight: Measured for preterm infants; mean birth weights were significantly different between the RDS and non-RDS groups.
gest_age: Measured for preterm infants; mean gestational ages were significantly different between the RDS and non-RDS groups.
